userStories.title: GSD & Ralph Integration
userStories.description: Integrate advanced meta-prompting systems (GSD + Ralph patterns) for project governance.
acceptanceCriteria: Ensure .agent/workflows are updated to reflect hybrid system
userStories.notes: Initial setup complete with GSD and Ralph patterns.

userStories.title: Elite Data Lab: Automated Outlier Removal
userStories.description: As a consultant, I want to automatically remove outliers from data so my forecasts are more accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Remove Outliers' button to Data Lab / Cleaning tab
Implementation uses Z-score or IQR method
Visual feedback shows how many rows were removed
userStories.notes: Implemented IQR-based outlier removal in Data Lab.

userStories.title: Strategy Hub: Comparative Channel Analysis
userStories.description: As a user, I want to compare marketing channel efficiency across multiple files.
acceptanceCriteria: New tab or sub-section for 'Comparative Analysis'
Table/Chart showing ROI/ROAS side-by-side for different campaigns
AI generates 'Winning Channel' insight based on cost vs revenue
userStories.notes: Implemented cross-table comparative ROI/ROAS analysis in the SaaS Strategy Hub.

userStories.title: Query Engine & Data Lab Precision
userStories.description: Optimize AI response boundaries and statistical visualizations.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent clearly distinguishes between SQL Querying and Forecasting
Distribution charts include Mean/Median markers and marginal box plots
Suggested insights properly populate the query field on click
userStories.notes: Fixed forecast-table hallucination and enhanced Data Lab visual clarity.

userStories.title: SaaS Refactoring (100K Scale)
userStories.description: Port project to Client-Server architecture (FastAPI + Streamlit) with GSD/Ralph patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend decoupled into FastAPI server with Ralph-style Supervisor
Frontend refactored to consume JSON API with Elite UI
Agno Agent Team implemented (Analyst + Researcher + Supervisor)
userStories.notes: Refactored to SaaS architecture with decoupled layers and elite governance.
